result.keyword: Where can I find a public database of backlink spam doorway domains and link-selling networks?
result.markdown:
There are several public datasets and research resources for identifying **backlink spam domains, doorway sites, private blog networks (PBNs), link farms, and link-selling networks**\.

The important distinction is that there isn't one authoritative public blacklist covering all these categories. The best approach is to combine domain-level backlink datasets with web-graph research.

## Best public databases and datasets

![Link Graph | Majestic](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mnO0MW_N2taVRIiN4ubkA5ywqWSwXbqKjXqjAPncJeDkv1VB6ipDgp6sEmPJQoNdsAK3zBYkt09-6wzrRUtfz0DiZiodUPPePgP9lrKD4S82oaJ3ewGBwbbJCD6qLiM_sLUtyjxjxXq-MpjgNTmCAyrbh9HCeVQp3djC-DlZeQez3xbwmPRTfI6J4hGZG2df?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. MapTheNet**

(Public dataset)

- Domain-to-domain link graph.
- Community IDs and outbound-link counts.
- Shared-link and network analysis.
- Useful for studying interconnected domain networks.

[Download MapTheNet data](https://www.mapthenet.org/data?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Datasets · Hugging Face](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/KGVOkIoDcTSvOg-mUpwbBEskd2KkkivC7E3wjt3CEQtlljP1kUqdovmXxW0pk0ovQ-ijg3DU2LBGjNOCRm-KkZgUWHnBu7Rtwwadx3nQpP3SpaludTcuvmO0K7Evn0f0Jz4gHcKfPPZQYfVjc0so6cSfkT8HsbRF7L_IpnQTnCNdWCPvzaHUJAilycn2rueL?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Domain Intelligence Dataset**

(Public dataset)

- Billions of domain-to-domain backlink edges.
- PBN and link-farm detection signals.
- Shared nameserver and DNS information.
- Authority and trust-style metrics.

Particularly relevant to link-network research.

[Explore dataset on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sskapci/domain-intelligence-dataset?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![DataForSEO Reviews | Read Customer Service Reviews of dataforseo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/W95k8-PJYfFST-oIY5i7ttGE7CrjSol99pN_Y-4Na69Nz1kKtoB772w7mp-vvj6Pwx4HXCyTfW-NiHkG4uWYgvCqjrwFymL3hM06j4oQL0gsnhrKPr39Zj2kFZT0qrqA__w_CuvE7tNr7X-p4NuNFBmY4j7cejurS9UwC-a_Y8ilP4fQHFnn6hkZ6nIrCWC2?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. DataForSEO Backlink Database**

(Commercial)

- Millions of domain backlink profiles.
- Domain Rank and Spam Score.
- Referring domain counts.
- JSON and CSV downloads.

Useful for building a large domain-level research dataset.

[Explore backlink database](https://dataforseo.com/databases/backlink-database?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![SURBL Multi Blacklist - Suped](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IBtK2_U3goGOwfLffZUh39lGGbd1m9TbSR1WxqC__b2Oixe7wb12YyMxq6m_8dCNDOO8INg0qLch6Ap_xPIaj7OOjocjrKPT9Ddp3dTL-KqFCOo3n0yjt4H4mXclGFrWgYVJRUgBi3UGIZzMGxBX14jM4FkXQVyADgNhwpXmwG4HlmOvQeoeOEy1e92rhKLe?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. SURBL**

(Public lists)

- Public abuse-domain datasets.
- Spam and malicious-domain intelligence.
- Useful as supplementary domain reputation data.

Note: It is not specifically a backlink-selling blacklist.

[Browse SURBL lists](https://www.surbl.org/lists?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Additional resources

| Resource | What it provides |
|--------|--------|
| [SEOkicks](https://en.seokicks.de/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | Large backlink index |
| [DataForSEO API](https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/databases-backlink_summary/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | Backlink summaries and spam metrics |
| [Google Search Console](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9044175?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | Actual links pointing to your website |
| [Google Spam Reports](https://developers.google.com/search/help/report-quality-issues?rd=2&visit_id=638744506117999215-128203102&utm_source=chatgpt.com) | Reporting suspected spam domains |


## Google's definitions of the spam you're researching

Google explicitly identifies these practices\:

- **Link spam\:** Buying or selling links to manipulate search rankings.
- **Doorway abuse\:** Multiple similar websites or pages designed to funnel visitors.
- **Expired domain abuse\:** Reusing expired domains primarily to manipulate rankings.

Official documentation: [Google Search spam policies](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/essentials/spam-policies?hl=en&rd=1&visit_id=639263619394756452-3529325438&utm_source=chatgpt.com)\.

## My recommendation

If your goal is to create a research database of backlink spam and link-selling networks, I'd start with\:

1. MapTheNet for domain relationships.
2. Domain Intelligence Dataset for PBN and link-farm research.
3. DataForSEO for backlink spam metrics.
4. SURBL for supplementary abuse-domain intelligence.

Treat automated spam classifications as indicators rather than proof that a domain sells links.

---

## One question to narrow this down

Are you looking for\:

- **A.** An existing downloadable CSV/TXT list of known backlink spam domains.
- **B.** A database of known link-selling websites and guest-post networks.
- **C.** A database of doorway domains, parasite SEO sites, and expired-domain abuse.
- **D.** A comprehensive dataset of interconnected PBNs and link farms.

I can focus the research on finding actual downloadable datasets, GitHub repositories, and public domain lists rather than commercial SEO tools.
